name: stremio-skip-addon
description: A self-hosted Stremio addon that removes intro, recap, credits and preview segments from your streams using TheIntroDB timings: it splices HLS playlists and remuxes progressive files.
author: TheIntroDB

scripts.dev: npm run build:css && tsx watch src/server.ts
scripts.test: npm run build:css && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
